title: Observation, model, and attribution are different claims
japanese_title: 観測・モデル・帰属主張の分離
summary: A heat anomaly is separated from model projection and attribution scope.
user_input: A recent heat anomaly is consistent with model projections of increased extreme heat frequency under a specified scenario, but a single event does not by itself prove the entire long-term model.
reason_for_tier: B-tier because model consistency and attribution framing are scoped and probabilistic.
audit_notes: Observation, model projection, and attribution are separate nodes.
key_warning_theme: Single-event observation is not long-term model proof.
